Independent exact symbolic verification and selected exhaustive rational path checks passed; finite checks are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparisons identify no prior exact classification of both distinct roots in the fixed-residual, three-equiangular-row Kaczmarz model. Han–Xie assume consistent equations; Gan–Wu analyze IID noisy row selection and neighborhood bounds; Recht–Ré compare matrix-product moments and stochastic noise of different correlation structure. The complete one-pass versus stationary crossover and the finite-epoch reversal are not implied by the examined statements. This is a provisional literature conclusion with explicit residual coverage risk.

value.rationale: The 3-by-2 equiangular tight frame is the smallest noncommuting, overdetermined perfectly conditioned Kaczmarz testbed, and its fixed least-squares inconsistency residual is forced for every right-hand side. Distinct sharp thresholds for single-pass forcing and stationary expected error reveal a concrete time-dependent reversal for standard RR and IID choices. Complete phase classification, including a rational witness and exact 7/3 limiting ratio, clarifies when noise-vs-homogeneous comparisons transfer; not an arbitrary narrow table recomputation.
